decision.note: FMS SystemInfoActivity is sorter-only, not ported to StreamsPlayer Android

Donor change adds register, password, account-delete, grant, clipboard and administration envelope types and reasons for roles this product does not declare (DEVICE-EXCHANGE pointer: no registration, clipboard, server or administration role). Receiver and cast types are unchanged. S0027 and S0028 carry the account types they use when they land.

Reviewed against the local connector: TLS 1.2 floor, handshake timeout and same-key renewal (publicKey, pin replaced in DeviceExchangeAccountClient) are already present in local shape. Not carried: the adopt hook (local connects are bounded by the 15 s connect and handshake timeouts and closed by the owning session), the connect trace lines, and the hand-rolled base64 for API 23 (phone minSdk is 26). Re-read with S0027 if the renewal verdict is ever needed by a caller.

Donor change adds own-account routing (ExchangeTunnelRouter, connectByResourceId) to the JSch Proxy of SFTP tunnels; the StreamsPlayer forwarder is a loopback media forwarder with no SFTP and no resource role (DEVICE-EXCHANGE pointer: never either resource role), so nothing here applies. Re-read when a resource role is ever declared.
